# DimOS

> Documentation for the new dimOS features: persistent maps, a web console, demo exploration, nearby/visual arrival, person recognition, a scene graph server, and VLM/segmentation perception — built on top of upstream dimOS, with one comparison of the original and the new feature set.

Every page is also served as markdown at its docs/ path: `usage/modules/` is
`usage/modules.md`, and a section's index page is `usage/index.md`.

- [dimOS: what's new](https://dobriclilujun.github.io/dimos/index.md)
